recognize_zh: 這是一張正面胸部 X 光，不是型態學影像：兩側肺容積偏小、橫膈抬高，上腹部被大片軟組織密度占據、左側腸氣被推擠至左下外側，提示肝脾腫大或腹腔腫塊；右下肺門旁有模糊浸潤陰影，需與臨床及斷層影像對照判讀。
features: Frontal (AP/PA) chest radiograph with low lung volumes
Elevated hemidiaphragms with a large homogeneous soft-tissue density occupying the upper abdomen
Bowel gas displaced to the left lateral and inferior abdomen, suggesting splenomegaly or a left upper quadrant mass
Ill-defined opacity in the right perihilar/lower zone
Mediastinum not markedly widened; external skin marker/electrode over the right shoulder
describe_en: This is a frontal chest radiograph rather than a morphologic specimen. Lung volumes are low with elevation of the hemidiaphragms, and a large homogeneous soft-tissue density occupies the upper abdomen, displacing bowel gas to the left lateral and lower abdomen, suggestive of marked hepatosplenomegaly or a large abdominal mass. An ill-defined opacity is present in the right perihilar and lower zone, which may represent atelectasis from diaphragmatic elevation, infiltrate or lymphomatous involvement. The mediastinum is not grossly widened. In a patient with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, these findings support bulky abdominal/visceral disease and warrant cross-sectional imaging (CT or PET-CT) for staging.

ddx.dx: Massive splenomegaly from myeloproliferative neoplasm (e.g., primary myelofibrosis, CML)
ddx.vs: Radiographic appearance is similar; distinguished by blood counts with leukoerythroblastosis or BCR::ABL1, and marrow findings.
Produces diffuse ground-glass abdominal density with centrally floating bowel loops rather than lateral displacement of gas by an organ mass.
Mimics diaphragm elevation, but lateral decubitus films or ultrasound show layering fluid and the gastric bubble is separated from the pseudo-diaphragm.
Cross-sectional imaging and biopsy separate lymphoma from metastases, storage disease or congestion.
